svg.aria-label: What's behind the friendly face of AI? A many-eyed, tentacled shoggoth wearing a pink human-ish mask with a little yellow smiley. Labels: Unsupervised learning (the beast), Supervised fine-tuning (the mask), RLHF the cherry on top (the smiley). PauseAI.

g.title: What's behind the friendly face of AI? — the shoggoth (PauseAI)
